nodes.speaker: pritchard
nodes.text: Temperance. The warrant names the books. You'll see what we take, and I'll sign for it. You can stay and watch us read. Let us finish.
nodes.effect_request: None. His promise alone creates no receipt, permission or item transfer.

nodes.speaker: vickers
nodes.text: Then every page stays with the book. Read it here. If you take it, Owen signs for it. I won't have eleven years of work turned into a loose handful of accusations.

choices.label: Read it here under the warrant.
choices.effect_request: Commit warranted inspection permission43 after the eligible exchange is acknowledged; keep the original book accessible in place.

choices.label: Ask Pritchard to sign for the book.

nodes.effect_request: No will knowledge, speech check, hostility, automatic surrender or physical step-aside.

nodes.speaker: pritchard
nodes.text: One bound book, every page accounted for. I'll put my name to that. If we read it to the town, we read what it says. We don't improve it to make our case easier.

choices.label: Accept the receipt and take the book.
choices.effect_request: Commit inspection permission43; request genuine receipt production and deliberate original-book transfer through the authoritative ledger. Record custody only after actual acknowledgment; do not retry an uncertain issue.

choices.label: Keep the book here. We'll read it first.
choices.effect_request: Commit warranted inspection permission43 only; no receipt or inventory action.

nodes.effect_request: No successful signature, paper custody or book transfer is inferred from this spoken offer alone.

documents.title: Receipt for Vane's bound account book
documents.text:
MERCY CROSSING

One bound account book, to remain complete for inspection under the warrant. Owen Pritchard assumes responsibility for its removal and accounting for its pages.

Owen Pritchard, Sheriff
documents.requires: Genuine eligible acceptance of the receipt route and actual generated original receipt. No pre-existing signature or transfer claim.

journal43: Beckett accepted inspection under Pritchard's warrant. The book must stay complete. Taking it away still needs his receipt and the actual book.
next_objective: Read Vane's black book. If you remove it for a public reading, obtain the receipt and carry the actual book to the porch.
limits: An accepted permission may persist, but later speech and effects require current original actors and context.
Keep will knowledge, inspection permission, document production, actual book custody and public reading separate.
Cancel or leaving grants no permission, receipt, transfer, threat or death.
Book reading can occur in place without taking it; nonlethal main progression requires neither the optional will nor a speech check.
If the physical doorway needs movement, verify that actual movement separately; stage43 never claims Beckett moved.
This is supplied original writing, not executable quest data, a compiled feature or installed content.
